class.name: VoxelBlockyModel
class.brief_description: Model stored in [VoxelBlockyLibrary] and used by [VoxelMesherBlocky].
class.description: Represents a model to be used for voxels of a specific TYPE value. Such models must be contained within a [VoxelBlockyLibrary] to be used with [VoxelTerrain] or directly with a [VoxelMesherBlocky]. A model can be setup in various ways, see child classes.

method.name: get_material_override
method.description: Gets the material override for a specific surface of the model.

method.name: get_mesh_ortho_rotation_index
method.description: Gets the 90-degree rotation ID that will be applied to the model when the library is baked.

method.name: is_mesh_collision_enabled
method.description: Tells if a specific surface produces mesh-based collisions.

method.name: set_material_override
method.description: Sets a material override for a specific surface of the model. It allows to use the same mesh on multiple models, but using different materials on each.

method.name: set_mesh_collision_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables mesh-based collision on a specific surface. It allows a model to have solid parts and others where players can pass through.

method.name: set_mesh_ortho_rotation_index
method.description: Gets the 90-degree rotation ID that will be applied to the model when the library is baked. This is a number representing one of 24 possible 90-degree rotations. You can also use [method rotate_90].

members.member: If false, this model is treated as air only when determining the rounded edges of neighboring blocks. This allows transparent grass tufts, shrubs and mesh-based water to leave neighboring bevels exposed. This does not enable rounding on the model itself or change its rendering, face culling, or collision settings. Bake the library and remesh after changing it.

Opts this model into neighborhood-aware rounding using the shared settings of [VoxelBlockyLibraryBase]. Disabled by default. Supported models are full unit cubes, including imported meshes with two triangles per face and each face contained in one mesh surface. Side cutouts must be disabled. Procedural [VoxelBlockyModelFluid] models are not rounded and are treated as air for neighboring rounding. UV coordinates must match at vertices shared by the two triangles of each face; different cube faces may use separate UV regions and materials. Unsupported shapes retain their original geometry and report a warning when baked. Rounding changes terrain mesh generation, not the stored voxel IDs or box collision AABBs. Rounded previews are not implemented yet; static model previews currently show the original model. After changing this property at runtime, bake the library and remesh affected terrain.
List of bounding boxes relative to the model. They are used for box-based collision, using [VoxelBoxMover]. They are not used with mesh-based collision.
Collision mask used for box-based collision [VoxelBoxMover] and voxel raycasts ([VoxelToolTerrain]). It is not used for mesh-based collisions.
Color of the model. It will be used to modulate its color when built into a voxel mesh.
If enabled, this voxel culls the faces of its neighbors. Disabling can be useful for denser transparent voxels, such as foliage.

If enabled and the terrain has LODs, this model will produce skirts when located at the edge of a chunk. This is intented to hide "cracks" between chunks of different LOD. You may turn this off if the model is transparent, as the skirt would become visible from behind other surfaces.
If enabled, voxels having this ID in the TYPE channel will be used by [method VoxelToolTerrain.run_blocky_random_tick].
Bitmask used to filter this model in some operations. For example, see [member VoxelToolTerrain.run_blocky_random_tick].

Determines how transparency is handled when the sides of the model are culled by neighbor voxels. If the neighbor voxel at a given side has a transparency index lower or equal to the current voxel, the side will be culled.
